# Changes

## 0.3.1+internal

- Upstream keywords are ignored with a DeprecationWarning instead of raising, so old scripts keep running.

## 0.3.0+internal

- Forked from upstream 0.3. Renamed `tablefmt` to `style` and `floatfmt` to `number_format`; dropped dict rows and `headers="keys"`.
- The platform team owns this fork. Open a ticket instead of patching it in place.
